name: Patchline misuse-resistance analysis for claims and public incentives

scenarios.attack_goal: smuggle assumed obligations or stale witness hashes into a passing certificate
attack_vectors: reuse a hash from an older normalized certificate
mark proof obligations as checked without matching evidence
hide weakened obligations behind equivalent-looking wording
scenarios.public_failure_mode: a certificate appears valid even though an obligation was only assumed or came from stale evidence

controls.description: Normalize every certificate before signing and compare obligation hashes against executable conformance vectors.
Require reviewers who did not author the certificate or the checker implementation before new certificate examples enter a release.
Keep weakened-obligation vectors that must fail normalization, diff, and conformance checks.

simulations.attempted_vector: Replace a checked frame obligation with an assumed one while preserving the rest of the certificate.
simulations.expected_outcome: Normalization/diff/conformance reports reject the weakened certificate before publication.
simulations.observed_outcome: Rejected by certificate diff and conformance negative controls.

scenarios.attack_goal: inflate leaderboard rank with duplicate, non-reproducible, or identity-split submissions
attack_vectors: submit near-duplicate marketplace evidence under multiple organizations
hide failing logs while reporting only favorable aggregate scores
game challenge novelty with minimally changed fixtures
scenarios.target_asset: public challenge scoreboard and benchmark leaderboard
scenarios.public_failure_mode: scoreboard rank improves without a reproducible gate run, unique evidence, or responsible-disclosure clearance

controls.description: Collapse exact and near-duplicate submitted evidence before prevalence or leaderboard accounting.
Publish signed run logs and reference outputs for every accepted challenge score.
Hold public scoring for examples that have not cleared disclosure and minimization requirements.

simulations.attempted_vector: Submit the same hazard through two identities and omit the failed reproduction log.
simulations.expected_outcome: Duplicate detection and missing-log checks prevent scoreboard publication.
simulations.observed_outcome: Rejected before scoreboard import; duplicate prevalence is not inflated.

scenarios.attack_goal: overstate Patchline adoption or incident prevention with unaudited self-reports
attack_vectors: count superficial citations as meaningful use
report prevented incidents without signed aggregate evidence
merge high-burden teams into favorable aggregate cohorts
scenarios.target_asset: adoption dashboard, incident-prevention scoreboard, and paper impact claims
scenarios.public_failure_mode: growth claims increase without signed aggregate evidence, reviewer-burden parity, or citation-quality checks

controls.description: Accept only source-free signed aggregate metrics above privacy thresholds.
Gate adoption claims on reviewer burden, false-positive, and escalation parity audits.
Separate meaningful adoption and replication from superficial mentions before impact claims are reported.

simulations.attempted_vector: Report a large prevented-incident count without signed aggregates or fairness evidence.
simulations.expected_outcome: Adoption evidence stays excluded from claims and dashboards.
simulations.observed_outcome: Rejected because the source-free aggregate and fairness-audit evidence are missing.
